The warranty does not cover normal wear and tear, accidental damage, misuse, or altered items [2: "The warranty doesn't cover normal wear and tear, damage from accidents or misuse, or items that have been altered."].

## Tracking says delivered, but I can't find it

Look around your door, your mailbox and your building's mail room, and ask your neighbors. Carriers sometimes mark a package as delivered shortly before it arrives, so wait until the end of the next business day. data.text:
## Hiking boots

Our boots fit true to size with a regular hiking sock. If you wear thick socks or are between sizes, choose the larger size. Feet swell during the day, so measure yours in the evening.
